claim: In the limit as the speed of light c tends to infinity, the relativistic Euler equations reduce to the classical compressible Euler equations.
falsifier: One can verify that as c increases, the relativistic Euler equations asymptotically approach the classical Euler equations by comparing solutions of both systems.

exclusions: limited to the formal limit of the relativistic Euler equations under a complete equation of state

title: Relativistic Euler equations–reduction to classical compressible theorem
